name: Axiom Intelligence Acquisition Corp 1 Units
summary: Formed on January 30, 2025, this entity operates as a Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC), often referred to as a blank-check firm. Its primary aim is to identify and integrate with a business in the European infrastructure landscape, encompassing areas like energy generation, digital transformation, and transport logistics. Each investment unit provides one Class A ordinary share, along with a distinct right that entitles the holder to one-tenth (1/10) of an additional Class A share upon the successful consummation of a merger or acquisition.
